headline: Asian Manufacturing Gets Off to a Good Start in the Second Half; Taiwan's New Orders Growth Ranks Near the Top in Nearly Five Years
summary: The latest Asian manufacturing indicator shows a positive start to the second half. Manufacturers are moving past the Middle East conflict impact, and cost pressures are easing.
why: Purchasing manager surveys such as these are closely watched leading indicators of factory output and trade demand across Asian economies.
